verdict.rationale: Gemini is closed-source proprietary software; there is no open-license source code available, and this axis does not apply to a closed commercial AI product the way it would to an open-source project — but since evidence shows no such offering, this is effectively unsupported. As the axis of 'reading open-licensed source' is a fair question that Google explicitly does not offer for Gemini, absence of evidence and known closed nature makes this not applicable to this proprietary product's category expectations.
